name: actor_1_failure_to_yield
description: Vehicle turns left across traffic without yielding to oncoming vehicles.

name: actor_2_safe_railway_wait
description: Vehicle stops safely behind the barrier and waits for the train to pass.

name: actor_3_pedestrian_railway_dash
description: Pedestrian ducks under the barrier to cross just before the train arrives.
